# function: format

Fills the scheme's template with its static values plus the variable parts in `variables`, checking each component against the scheme's constraints. Define the scheme once with `scheme` and pass it to every call.

The optional third argument holds per-resource-type rules, as returned by `rules`. They are applied in this order:

1. `lowercase`: lowercase every part.
2. `remove`: delete characters matching a regular expression.
3. `fit`: shrink one component so the name fits `max_length`. Its budget comes from the declared maximum lengths of the other components, so it is the same in every environment.
4. `min_length`, `max_length`: check the length of the whole name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
locals {
  naming = {
    scheme = provider::naming::scheme(
      "{org}-{env}-{region}-{type}-{name}",
      {
        org    = "acme"
        env    = "prod"
        region = "weu"
      },
    )
  }
}

# acme-prod-weu-rg-network
output "resource_group_name" {
  value = provider::naming::format(local.naming.scheme, {
    type = "rg"
    name = "network"
  })
}

# Pass rules as a third argument for resource types with their own limits,
# e.g. local.naming.rules.key_vault. See the `rules` function for a complete example.
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
format(config object, variables map of string, rules dynamic...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `config` (Object) A scheme, as returned by `scheme`.
1. `variables` (Map of String) Values for the placeholders not set in the scheme's `static`.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `rules` (Variadic, Dynamic, Nullable) Optional per-resource-type rules.
